lines.text: Your playable got rejected.
Again.
It worked perfectly...
...on your phone.
But on a tablet?
In landscape?
Seventeen devices...
two orientations. Thirty-four screens.
And twenty-seven ad networks, each with its own rules.
That's over six hundred checks.
By hand, it takes hours.
And something still slips through.
Hi, I'm Micky! Play it once, and I'll check the rest.
Here's how it works.
You play the game once, on your phone.
Every tap is replayed...
on all thirty-four screens at once.
Four steps, and you're done.
Step one: upload your playable.
One HTML file, or a zip with builds for every network.
I'll sort out the networks for you.
And every past check is right at hand.
Like this one: the build links to the wrong app in the App Store. Caught before it ships!
Step two: play it.
Scan the QR code with a phone on the same Wi-Fi.
No phone? Use your mouse, let the AI play, or just check that it loads.
Step three: I replay your session on every screen.
File size, format, install button, errors, FPS, sound...
And if something's off, I'll show you exactly where.
I even tell you how long is left.
Step four: one clear verdict.
Ready. Needs a look. Or not ready.
With a full report underneath.
Download it as one file and send it to your team.
Start it with a double click.
Teammates just open the address in a browser...
with nothing to install.
The whole team checks in one place.
Before: hours and risk. Now: minutes and confidence.
Play it once. Leave the rest to Micky!
Just double-click PlayGuard dot command, and try it today!
